verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Tilled is a payments platform for ISVs and a graduated path toward registered payfac status is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the pack describes tiers or a migration path to registered payment facilitation, nor any shift of economics or liability as a platform scales. Merchant pricing templates and Enterprise white-label custom domains concern pricing setup and branding, not graduating toward registered payfac status without replatforming.
